SK9031 An analyzer package failed to load

A hosted analyzer package named in skala.jsonc could not be loaded. Never fatal.

CategoryTool
Default severitywarning
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.6

Why

ADR-008: third-party rules are hosted, never bundled. A package that is missing, is for another framework, or drags a conflicting dependency is a configuration problem to report, not a reason to produce no report at all.

When it does not fire

None; it reports a load that failed.

Configuration

  • skala.jsonc: analysis.hostedAnalyzers
